question: Should OpenClaw reintroduce `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a deprecated compatibility alias, and should that alias include only the inbound-shaped helper names in this PR or the full pre-removal helper set?
rationale: This is a plugin API compatibility/deprecation contract decision: the source fix is narrow, but accepting or narrowing the legacy surface affects third-party plugins and future removal policy.

options.title: Refresh And Land Scoped Alias
options.body: Resolve the conflict and land the object-identical alias if maintainers accept `turn` as a deprecated compatibility surface with the helper names implemented here.

options.title: Broaden Legacy Helper Scope
options.body: Before merge, require the alias to also cover the older helper names that existed immediately before removal, or document why they are intentionally excluded.

options.title: Reject Core Alias
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers decide old channel plugins must update to `channel.inbound.*` instead of expanding the core runtime surface again.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Land Scoped Alias
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict and land the object-identical alias if maintainers accept `turn` as a deprecated compatibility surface with the helper names implemented here.

likelyOwner.reason: The removal commit and associated docs/tests trace the compatibility decision back to this author most clearly.
